name: @nivo-lite/cells-author
description: The authoring helper of NIVO V2 cells: typed builders that EMIT the seed data files (cell.yaml, graph.yaml, cells.package.yaml, byte-stable), the compile step that turns a cell's TypeScript origin into the ONE self-contained JavaScript text the cell stores, `emit --check`, and the ambient types for cell sources. It runs outside the engine; the engine never imports it (gate D of the cells-isolation check).
